parameters.name: FaceBase64
parameters.description:
The Base64-encoded face image.
> Specify either FaceUrl or FaceBase64.

parameters.name: FaceInputType
parameters.description:
The input type of the face material. Valid values:

- IMAGE (default): face image
- VIDEO: face video

> Video processing takes longer. Set the timeout to more than 3 seconds.

parameters.name: FaceUrl
parameters.description:
The URL of the face image.
> Specify either FaceUrl or FaceBase64.

parameters.name: OuterOrderNo
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the merchant request. The value is a 32-character alphanumeric string. The first few characters consist of a custom merchant abbreviation, the middle part can contain a time segment, and the last part can use a random or incremental sequence.
